_comment: INVALID example — annotated with the specific violations for training/validation-test purposes. Remove _comment and _violations before using as a test fixture; they are not part of the schema (additionalProperties:false would reject them too).
_violations: queue_name does not follow <tenant-scope>.<domain>.<purpose> pattern (only two segments present) (violates Constitution §6.6 / VAL-109)
fifo.enabled is true but fair_share is missing entirely — fair-share is mandatory even under FIFO (violates RULE-019 / VAL-110)
dead_letter is missing entirely (violates RULE-038 / VAL-111)
visibility_timeout (PT5S) is less than metadata.max_processing_time_ms (45000ms = 45s), so a job would be picked up twice before it finishes (violates Queue Contract §4 invariant / VAL-114)
throughput.max_messages_per_second is 0, which does not protect nor permit any dispatch (violates schema minimum:0.1 / VAL-116)
idempotency_required is false while retry.max_attempts > 0, risking duplicate side-effects on retry (violates RULE-038 / VAL-118)
priority is 0, outside the 1-10 range (violates schema minimum:1 / VAL-120)
